Real-Time Collaboration

See live updates from other users working on the same project data.

WebSocket

WebSocket endpoint for real-time project collaboration.

This module provides the WebSocket endpoint that clients connect to for real-time presence tracking and cache invalidation.

Endpoint

GET /ws/projects/{project_id}

The client connects using a WebSocket URL with a JWT token in the query string:

ws://localhost:8000/ws/projects/{project_id}?token={jwt_token}

Authentication

The JWT token is extracted from the token query parameter and validated using the same decode_access_token function used by HTTP endpoints. If the token is invalid or expired, the connection is closed with code 1008 (Policy Violation).

Message Protocol

Once connected, the client subscribes to the project channel by sending a SUBSCRIBE message. The server then sends a WELCOME message containing the current presence state of all other users in the project.

The client should send HEARTBEAT messages every 15 seconds to maintain the connection and update its focus state. If no heartbeat is received within 30 seconds, the connection is considered stale.

Example Client Flow

  1. Connect: new WebSocket('/ws/projects/{id}?token={token}')

  2. Subscribe: ws.send(JSON.stringify({type: 'SUBSCRIBE', project_id: id}))

  3. Receive WELCOME with current presence state.

  4. Send HEARTBEAT every 15 seconds with current focus state.

  5. Handle incoming events (NODE_MUTATED, USER_FOCUS_CHANGED, etc.).

  6. On disconnect, send UNSUBSCRIBE or let the server detect stale state.
